title: Blocs explained: NATO, BRICS, QUAD, SCO
summary: Who is in which club, and why some countries sit in rival clubs at once.

stops.caption: NATO is a military alliance of 32 countries in North America and Europe. An attack on one counts as an attack on all.
BRICS began with Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa and has since added members. It focuses on trade and finance.
Australia, India, Japan and the United States work together in the QUAD on maritime security and technology.
The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation links China, Russia, India, Pakistan, Iran and Central Asian states on security.
India belongs to the QUAD and also to BRICS and the SCO, keeping ties open with rival powers.
Blocs overlap. Being in the same club shows shared interests, not that members always agree.
